title: GTA 6 Reveals a Massive and Detailed Open World Across Leonida
summary: Rockstar Games has revealed more details about GTA 6's huge open world, including its regions, wildlife, weather systems and activities across Leonida.
content:
Grand Theft Auto VI continues to generate massive attention as Rockstar Games reveals more information about the game's world ahead of its November 19, 2026 release.

The upcoming game takes place across the fictional state of Leonida, with Vice City serving as one of its major locations. Rockstar's latest information shows that the world is designed to be significantly larger and denser than GTA V.

Leonida is divided into several distinct regions, including Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park. Each area is designed with different environments, activities and wildlife.

Weather is also expected to play a major role. Rockstar has shown improved weather effects, including rain, puddles, wet surfaces and changing conditions that can alter the appearance of the world.

The game will feature Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos as its two central protagonists. Their story follows the pair after a seemingly simple criminal job goes wrong and pulls them into a larger conspiracy across Leonida.

Players will also have many activities outside the main story. These include jet skiing, kayaking, scuba diving, mini golf, gyms, racing, billiards and other activities spread throughout the open world.

Rockstar has continued releasing new screenshots and footage throughout 2026, giving players a closer look at Vice City, rural areas, vehicles, characters and wildlife.

Grand Theft Auto VI is currently scheduled to launch on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. With the release date approaching, Rockstar is expected to reveal even more information about the game before launch.
